title: Firma en movimiento
prompt:
STRUCTURE FIRST: a webpage with a slim white navigation band, then an open asymmetric personal introduction occupying the upper 590px, and the first work image beginning naturally in the lower third. The name and professional role align on a single stable reading axis near x110. Name 'Alejandro Ortiz Corro' on two artfully fitted lines, around 88px with a distinctly humanist slightly calligraphic sans voice, clear not whimsical. Role at 32px directly below, short paragraph 23px with good line spacing, one small solid honey action. This is 'Firma en movimiento': a kinetic title identity with ONE continuous broad olive brush-like flowing stroke that starts quietly near the name's baseline, sweeps through the EMPTY right half, then becomes the top and right edge of a LARGE first project aperture at the bottom. It is an original abstract gestural stroke, not a forged signature or lettering and not a 3D ribbon. It has a confident asymmetrical organically drawn contour and rich flat pigment, with a small apricot counter-shape only where it meets the image. The stroke never crosses or obscures any text. The ONE software image sits in the opening below the introduction, at least 650px wide, using the supplied Central Belleza screenshot. Most of the upper view is calm white; personality comes from exact type and the confident SINGLE gesture, not many decorations. Project title and brief category follow the lower-left reading axis. The gesture acts as a continuous path into work. No loose pictograms or little marks. Beautiful refined authored contemporary digital craft.
Create ONE polished, production-quality desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE DESIGN COMP, landscape 1536 x 1024, straight-on browser content without device mockup. This is AOHYS, the personal portfolio of Alejandro Ortiz Corro, a senior full-stack software engineer with special strength in frontend. Visitor task: understand WHO HE IS immediately, then explore his real software work. Use Spanish copy verbatim. The approved brand palette is white #FFFFFF, brown ink #473C33, honey #FEC868, olive #ABC270, apricot #FDA769. Page ground is real white, never beige. Elegant, vibrant, human, restrained, carefully composed, exceptional typographic craft. A crisp distinctive humanist sans with confident medium weight, not brutal heavy bold and not generic serif magazine. No badges, metrics, technology icons, eyebrow labels, dashboards, diagram nodes, repeated cards, awards, fake portraits, fake claims, decorative 3D blobs, gradients or dark glows. One main action and one focal image only. The page contains the PERSON first and a real project as evidence second. The six-project inventory, architecture depth and two collaboration paths will appear progressively lower on the site: DO NOT cram them into the hero. Nav top has a plain small wordmark 'aohys', links 'Trabajo', 'Arquitectura', 'CV', 'Contacto', and quiet 'EN / ES'. The wordmark is provisional typography, no invented emblem.
Exact main content: 'Alejandro Ortiz Corro' (large but calm, clear name), 'Ingeniero de software full-stack.' (highly legible professional identity), 'Desarrollo productos desde los requisitos hasta su entrega, con una base especialmente fuerte en frontend.' (one brief, readable supporting paragraph), and primary button 'Conoce mi trabajo'. Under the hero, the beginning of a project reads 'The Barber Central' and 'Producto para negocios de belleza', with a quiet 'Ver proyecto' link. No other project thumbnails. Use the attached image ONLY as the real software evidence INSIDE the one project region; preserve the recognizable Central Belleza page, its salon illustration and page hierarchy. Do not borrow that screenshot's serif typography or beige coloring for the surrounding AOHYS page. Do not copy its sales promises outside the project image. An image comp is a proposal, not proof of a working website. Return the single complete image.
